parseNotes: Accept the exact concept labels Qualified plug-in electric vehicle credit (TY2020–TY2022) and Clean vehicle credit (TY2023).
TY2023 footnote A49 separately places previously owned clean vehicle credit in Other nonrefundable credits, so the Clean vehicle credit column is not the section 25E aggregate.
Read the positive whole number directly; the request unit is count and requires no scaling.
